on: Apron on, tray up; the counter has its banana.
off: The counter goes quiet, with warm cups still on the shelf.

receipt.title: Counter Take
receipt.line: The propeller turns above the square, and one cup is still warm.
receipt.none: The counter kept its company; the cups stayed stacked and dry.
receipt.capped: The cups went down the lane; today’s tips have already gone home.

idle: The rope is clear; the counter is open.
front: Bean’s coffee kiosk. Ask Bean for a job to serve coffee here for tips.

perfect: A neat cup crosses the rope without a wobble.
The foam sits high, pleased with its little roof.
That cup leaves warm hands around it.
The grounds settle into a tidy little weather map.
fine: A warm cup heads down the lane.
The milk finds its place and stays there.
The cup goes out with a sensible amount of steam.
One ordinary good cup joins the square.
wrong: That cup cools beside the grinder.
The order stays at the rope a moment longer.
The foam slumps quietly into the cup.
A cup and its order part ways by the lane.

left: Somebody turns from the rope, leaving the lane a little emptier.
